description: Hourly Consumption by Postal Code - 7 Digits is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). This DataSet is built based on the load diagrams collected by smart meters. In cases where there are not yet meters with the capacity to carry out these collections, or there is difficulty in communicating with them, consumption profiling is carried out. See here the document that systematizes the methodology for estimating the different profiles. Coverage: Portugal. The portal files it under Consumption and Energy. The portal shows 2023-10-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
